paragraphs.text: OpenDesign 订阅额度（5h/7d）面板与顶栏进度条 · DeepSeek Harness 插件
**English** | 中文
# dsh-od-quota
> Unofficial plugin: not affiliated with Open Design / Powerformer. It only reads your own account's
allowance through the public control-plane endpoints.
OpenDesign subscription quota inside DSH. Three surfaces read the same reading:
| Surface | Where | What it does |
| Quota page | Left sidebar "OpenDesign Quota" icon → full center page | 5-hour / 7-day windows, wal

let, sign-in and approval |
| Settings summary | Settings sidebar "OpenDesign Quota" | Status, two m

ini bars, refresh / open page, auto-refresh and header toggles |
| Header meter | Session title bar,
right of the title (left of the "Open in app" arrow) | Plan + two remaining bars; degrades when the
row is tight; click to open the page |
The bars are coloured by remaining percentage (green = plenty, amber = watch, red = nearly dry); sta
le data is dimmed and explained in the tooltip.
## What it reads
OpenDesign cloud has two planes; quota lives on the control plane:
| Plane | Host | Key | Use |

| Control | `amr-api.open-design.ai` | `vela_ctrl_…` | plan, wallet, 5h/7d windows, workspace |
| Mo
del | `amr-link.open-design.ai/v1` | `sk-amr_…` | inference |
`sk-amr_…` **cannot read quota** (the control plane refuses it), so the plugin uses the control plan
e. `vela_ctrl_…` is not printed on any page; it is issued by the CLI device-authorization flow (the
same flow as `vela login`) — the plugin runs that flow for you.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web` once after installing. The left sidebar then shows an "OpenDesign Quota" icon, and
Settings gets a summary entry.
## How it works
1. When the quota page or the settings summary opens without a key, the plugin calls `POST /api/v1/c
li/device-authorizations` and gets an approval link plus a 6-character code; the page shows the code

, a countdown, and a copyable link.
2. You sign in to OpenDesign in the browser and approve; the plu
gin polls out the `controlKey` and stores it in the DSH credential service (reference name `OPENDESI

GN_CONTROL_KEY` by default; change it with `keyRef`).
3. After that it reads `billing/preflight` + `
billing/summary` once every 60 seconds and writes the result into this plugin's `quotaJson`; the pag

e, the settings summary and the header meter all parse only that document.
4. A manual refresh write
s `refreshNonce` (a timestamp plus a sequence number, so two clicks never collide); the Host notices
the change and reads immediately. A refused write is reported with a retry hint instead of a button

that appears to do nothing.
5. A 15-second watchdog checks the last read against the **wall clock**
: a missed tick, a request that never returns, or a write the settings editor refused is all repaire
request that never returns, or a write the settings editor refused is all repaired on the next pass.
Device authorization is the primary path; pasting `vela_ctrl_…` directly also works. Pasting `sk-amr
_…` is rejected by the UI with an explanation.
## UI details
- **Quota page**: full-height scrolling page, content centred at 960px. Two large cards (5-hour / 7-
day) show a big percentage, an 8px bar, remaining / limit money, and a reset countdown; the wallet g
ets its own card; the footer shows the read time and the `powered by dsh` badge. Countdowns tick eve

ry 30 seconds.
- **Settings summary**: a status row, two mini bars, refresh / open page, and two swi
tches for existing config fields: `autoRefresh` (read every 60 s) and `enabled` (reading + header me

ter).
- **Header meter**: 28px tall, borderless, hover background — the same size and tokens as the
header icon buttons. Its width is chosen from the space the host title row actually leaves: full (pl
an + two 44px bars) → compact (no plan + 26px bars) → mini (state dot + worst percentage) → hidden.

Clicking it opens the quota page.
- **Colour and theme**: only `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-radius-*` /

`--dsw-focus-ring-*` host tokens; light/dark follow automatically.
- **Bilingual**: copy follows DSH
's language setting (Settings → General → Language); strings live in the `COPY` table in `client.js`
; other language packs fall back to English.
## When things fail
- **A read fails but a previous reading exists**: the last numbers stay, marked `status: "stale"`; t
he page shows "Data is stale" plus the reason and the meter is dimmed. A network blip is never repor

ted as "you are signed out".
- **No reading has ever succeeded**: the page shows "not connected" and

the concrete failure, not 0%.
- **`enabled: false`**: no polling; the header meter does not render;

the quota page shows a disabled notice and an Enable button.
- **A request hangs (connection black
hole, neither returns nor errors)**: every request has an outside deadline in addition to its `Abort
Signal`, so one hang costs at most one round; a reading still pending after two timeouts is abandone

d and restarted, and later refreshes never join a promise that will never resolve.
- **Control plane
401**: one automatic re-sign-in, at most once per 5 minutes, so the 60-second poll does not become

a device-authorization generator.
- **Sign out**: the credential is removed, the Host publishes `unc
onfigured` at once, the page returns to the sign-in state, and the header meter disappears — no stal

e numbers are left behind.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- The control-plane API is a private contract. If its fields change, the page and logs show the fail

ure (logs record field names, not values); the plugin never invents numbers.
- The header meter's wi
dth measurement relies on the host title row's layout containers (`container-type` plus the title cl
uster / utilities boxes). If the host changes that structure, the meter falls back to the full layou

t — it will not crash, but it may be less compact than intended.
- Money uses `creditsPerUsd`; when

the API omits the rate, 10,000 credits = $1; amounts below one cent show `< $0.01`.
- Copy lives in
the `COPY` table in `client.js` and is bilingual following the host language; it is not registered i

n the Client locale namespace, so third-party language packs fall back to English.
- Single account

only; multiple accounts would need `keyRef` to become a list.
- The settings footer inlines the offi
cial `dsh-badge.png` (121×20, data URI) so it renders offline.
